article.headline: Hornets take on the Nets on 6-game slide
article.description: Brooklyn Nets (4-14, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Charlotte Hornets (4-13, 13th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Hornets take on the Nets on 6-game slide
article.linkText: Hornets take on the Nets on 6-game slide
article.story: Brooklyn Nets (4-14, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Charlotte Hornets (4-13, 13th in the Eastern Conference) Charlotte, North Carolina; Saturday, 6 p.m. EST LINE: Hornets -5.5; over/under is 213.5 BOTTOM LINE: Charlotte aims to end its six-game skid when the Hornets take on Brooklyn. The Hornets are 4-9 in conference play. Charlotte is last in the Eastern Conference scoring 38.0 points per game in the paint. The Nets are 3-11 in conference play. Brooklyn is 0-9 against opponents with a winning record. The Hornets are shooting 40.4% from the field this season, 7.7 percentage points lower than the 48.1% the Nets allow to opponents. The Nets average 110.2 points per game, 0.4 fewer than the 110.6 the Hornets give up. The teams square off for the third time this season. The Nets won 114-104 in the last matchup on Nov. 5. Michael Porter Jr. led the Nets with 26 points, and Naz Reid led the Hornets with 28 points. TOP PERFORMERS: Brandon Miller is shooting 37.2% and averaging 20.9 points for the Hornets. Reid is averaging 19.0 points over the last 10 games. Porter is averaging 19 points and 6.8 rebounds for the Nets. Julius Randle is averaging 22.6 points and 5.1 rebounds while shooting 53.2% over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Hornets: 1-9, averaging 102.7 points, 46.1 rebounds, 22.1 assists, 7.0 steals and 4.1 blocks per game while shooting 40.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 113.6 points per game. Nets: 2-8, averaging 113.0 points, 38.9 rebounds, 26.1 assists, 8.2 steals and 4.3 blocks per game while shooting 47.0% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 124.2 points. INJURIES: Hornets: Kon Knueppel: out (hamstring), Dennis Schroder: out (hamstring), Ryan Kalkbrenner: day to day (hip), Grayson Allen: day to day (concussion protocol). Nets: Nolan Traore: out (hamstring), Moritz Wagner: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
